judged_text: add_members silently skips usernames that match no user and still renders success_json, and the diff deletes the spec that pinned this behavior ("succeeds silently when adding non-existent users") without replacing it. An admin who typos a username in the new Add members box gets a success response and a reloaded list that simply lacks the user, with no error anywhere; the behavior is also now unpinned, so a future change to raise a 422 (or to break the skip) ships undetected.

adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members, usernames are split and any that don’t resolve via User.find_by_username are silently ignored, and the action still renders success_json as long as group.save succeeds (no feedback about missing users). The diff also removes the prior spec that explicitly pinned this silent-skip behavior ("succeeds silently when adding non-existent users") and does not add an equivalent test for the new add_members endpoint, so this edge-case behavior is now unpinned and could change unnoticed.
